convoLines.text: Ruby: "Can I ask you something? ... I want us to stick together. Properly. Watch each other's backs."
"Stick together, then." They look steadier already.
"Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
Something eases in their shoulders. "Good. We're better with you here. I mean that."
Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.
"Still on whether you're staying. — or so they tell me."
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"Anyway — that's my problem, not yours. What did you want?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "I dreamed Heinrich was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
"And... scene. Good talk."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"God, yes. That's the dream now. Eight hours of not being afraid."
"Hah. A full night's sleep. Not safety, not answers — just eight hours where nothing needs me. That's my whole theology now."
"Still on what you're hoping for."
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Since Heinrich died... I keep expecting to see Heinrich at the fire. Stupid."
"Okay I really have to move now or I'll explode — talk soon!"
They glance at the fire, then back. The quiet doesn't seem to bother them.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff."
Quiet. "Yeah. I think everyone's carrying one of those."
"Maybe it's only me — I regret the ordinary days I rushed through. All those Winnipeg, Canada mornings I spent annoyed at small things. I'd pay anything for one annoyed morning now."
"If I may — Still on your regrets."
"Another time. The village needs me here."
"...Never mind me. What were you going to say?"
"Heinrich always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
"I keep turning over the last thing Heinrich said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"Rest when you can. We'll talk again soon."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we left it mid-thought, 4 days back. 'And... scene. Good talk.' But what do I know."
"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."
It's quiet at the trap line. Ruby doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.
"I'm staying out of the naming fight. For now. Someone always gets precious about their pick."
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
"Still on what's been happening."
They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Ruby grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"Sure — what's on your mind?"
"Good question." "I'd follow you out past the treeline. Don't tell the others — they'd want to come too."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Ruby is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
"Sure. I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we left it mid-thought, 4 days back. 'Okay I really have to move now or I'll explode — talk soon!'"
"I have opinions about the name. I am saving them for when they count."
"Anyway." A small smile.
"Still on what's been happening. Anyway, I should move."
Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Ruby nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Yeah? What's up?"
"Good question." "You're one of the good ones. Don't make me regret saying that out loud." "That's where we are."
You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"Sure. I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"You said you're staying — you didn't expect to say it, but you said it. Still true?"
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Still on that personal stuff."
A beat. Then, as if shaking something off:
You show them Makhana (Fox Nut) — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"Yeah? What's up?"
"You asked me that before. It's a different question now." "The Moot. They just... took you. Came back like nothing happened. It wasn't nothing."
"I show up. That's my part."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
DeAndre nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"This was good." They mean it.
"You wanted one full night's sleep — no waking up listening. Had it yet?"
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"Still on that personal stuff."
They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.
"Sure — what's on your mind?"
"Last time things were different. They always are." "They took you — The Moot, on the screens. The whole fire watched. Nobody knew where to look."
"I do the small things right. The big things notice."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Ruby nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"This was good." They mean it.

d9: "I keep turning over the last thing Heinrich said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."

lines: d6: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d6: 🕯️ Heinrich Stepanov is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d6: What Heinrich kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d6: Sofia picks up the journal. Their hands shake. Then they open it, and keep writing.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d6: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d6: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d6: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Heinrich Stepanov, 6 days. The mantle passes to Sofia Chen.
d6: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Sofia Chen, 29 — a community gardener. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm.

lastSay: d32: — DAY 32 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d32: 🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
d32: "I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
d32: (337 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
d32: You wake with a start — something is wrong.
